name: Recital G
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: whereas, since 2021, a proportion of the funding has been allocated to categories such as ‘sustainability’ and ‘healthy diets’, and in certain years, specifically to fruit and vegetables, including legumes, for which the Commission could assess the possibility of distinguishing them from the broader fruit and vegetables category to facilitate more accurate sectoral analysis, while ensuring consistency with the Common Market Organisation Regulation[[7]](#footnote-8); whereas promotion campaigns may influence food choices; whereas all priorities have to be implemented in a balanced and non-discriminatory manner among the various categories of agricultural products so as to ensure fair conditions for access to funding and maintain the competitiveness of the European agri-food sector; whereas meat, dairy products and wine are part of Europe’s cultural heritage and an important component of the EU agricultural economy and should not be discriminated against or stigmatised in future promotion work programmes;
